tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.description: Call after each completed step with the state you would need to continue (cursor, ids done, partial results; up to 256 KB JSON). Pro saves it (last 20 per run, kept 30 days). Free watch-only saves nothing and returns would_save: exactly what would have been stored. Never put passwords or API keys in

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Call FIRST when a run starts. If a checkpoint exists for run_id (Pro), returns the last step, state and done list: continue from there and skip finished work. If none, start fresh.

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: List recent checkpoints (step, size, time) for one run or all runs on your key.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Draft a plain-English report of the last 7 days: runs, checkpoints saved (Pro) or that would have been saved (free). Read-only; sends nothing.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $49/month All Access upgrade link (cloudforbots.com/offer). Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_checkpoint" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
